data.gender_notes: Esna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sn' meaning 'to save, to help'. In Islamic tradition, Esna is a name for a compassionate and caring woman, one who is a source of comfort and support to those around her. The name Esna carries the meaning “Rescuer, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Esna usually hope their child will grow to embody rescuer, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
